children.name: motion.preset_name.path
children.codeComponentDescription:
Animates the trim of a vector path. Replaces and subsumes Path Draw and Path Travel under a single preset; pick a `type` to drive the behaviour.

Properties:
- type: "Draw" reveals the path from start to end; "Erase" hides it; "Travel" runs a short segment along the path; "Custom" exposes raw `pathTrimStart` / `pathTrimEnd` control via the `axis` prop.
- direction: "Forward" or "Reverse"; reverses the animation direction.
- segment: For type=travel, length of the moving segment as a percentage of the path.
- axis: For type=custom, picks which trim field(s) to animate. "Path trim start" and "Path trim end" each drive one field. "Combined" drives both with shared timing but distinct initial values (`pathStartStartFrame`, `pathEndStartWithDivider`).
- pathStart{StartFrame,EndFrame} / pathEnd{StartFrame,EndFrame}: For type=custom, the per-trim frame values. The bespoke component shows only the subset relevant to the current axis selection.
- delay / duration / easing: Shared timing for every type (Draw / Erase / Travel and Custom).
